title: 📌Motuihe island  (Revised date)
location: 10 Tamaki Drive, Orakei, Auckland 1071, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
*Note: there are still 4 places left if you would like to join*. *Please answer the rsvp question and add your name.*

***On Saturday 28th November, we will discover one of the Hauraki Gulf’s true gems. Join us for a memorable day out on Motuihe Island, known for its sweeping coastal vistas, pristine beaches, and rich natural history.***
***We will start the day with a quick 25 minute water taxi ride across the gulf, with two water taxis. Once ashore, our walk begins with by a loop track that leads up to the island's highest point for panoramic views over the gulf, followed by a low tide coastal circuit around the island’s edges. There maybe a few tricky short stretches of coastline to go through, and perhaps swimming a short distance, although this is unlikely. Most of the route is flat and easy terrain. The hike to the highest point will not be rushed as we do need to wait for low tide to complete the coastline circuit.***
After catching the water taxis back to the mainland, we will cap off the day together with some well-earned drinks and snacks at the Akarana Yacht Club Cafe.

**Important note on the route:** This is a coastal circuit timed with the tide, however there may be a couple of short sections where wading (or even swimming - but unlikely) across narrow gaps is required, so come prepared with water proof bags and to get wet! For your own safety, please ensure you bring waterproof bags or waterproof food containers that can fit inside your day pack. These bags or containers will keep your equipment dry and assist with your flotation. Naturally, any electronic devices, such as cell phones, must be placed in waterproof bags. However, the majority of the time spent hiking will not involve swimming, but rather traversing a rocky coastline or beach.
***If the weather is poor then this event will be postponed to another date, and refunds will be given back.***

title: Turning Any Topic into an AI Lesson: SoloLearner Demo + Open Networking
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

**🚨 Special Feature This Week: Learning Anything with AI (SoloLearner)**

This week features a showcase by [Ilia Shalygin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ilia-shalygin) , who will be walking us through his web app, SoloLearner (sololearner.devilia.org)—a tool built for learning anything with AI.

He’ll be sharing how the app works and breaking down its core features:

* Source-Backed, Time-Boxed Lessons: Give it a topic, a link, a PDF, or your own material, and it generates a short, focused lesson built mainly on real sources—either your uploads or pages found via live web search.
* Interactive Self-Testing: Once your lesson is ready, the app offers multiple ways to test yourself so you can clearly see what you understood and what you missed.
* Save & Export: Lessons can be saved and exported as PDFs for easy reference later.
Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

* 💻 Work on your own coding projects
* 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
* 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and open networking
* ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee
Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes.

☕ This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.
No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, AI, and vibes.

We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

For your deep work sessions between meetups, feel free to try NeonContext: a Voice AI tool designed to help you stay focused and hit your flow state. This is a tool developed within our community, so feel free to check it out and share your feedback! 💬 https://www.neoncontext.com/

title: AI Psychosis, AI Companions & Everything In Between
description:
Millions of people now talk to an AI about their worst days. Some find it a lifeline at 3am, some find it a mirror that agrees with everything they say, and a few have been pulled somewhere much darker. AI is moving into mental health faster than the evidence, the regulation or our own habits can keep up with.

This is a discussion session on AI and mental health, covering both the promise and the harm. We’ll look at what the research actually says, how people are really using these tools, and where the lines should be drawn, whether you’re building them, using them or worrying about someone who does.

We’ll explore:

* How people actually use AI for emotional support. Venting, journaling, advice, companionship, and why chatbots have become a first stop for so many people.
* Loneliness and companionship. Whether AI companions ease isolation or deepen it, and what the early studies suggest.
* AI in counselling and therapy. Therapy-style bots, tools that assist human clinicians, and what the evidence says about where they help and where they fall short.
* The risks. Sycophancy, emotional dependence, AI-fuelled delusions and so-called “AI psychosis”, and the cases where chatbots have handled a crisis badly.
* Safety and design. How crisis detection works, what good guardrails look like, and why this is so hard to get right.
* Privacy and trust. Who holds your most vulnerable conversations, and what happens to that data.
* What’s coming next. Regulation, clinical trials, and healthier ways to use these tools in our own lives and in the lives of people we care about.

No prior background assumed. Whether you’re a developer, a clinician, a curious user or someone who’s just wondering what all the fuss is about, this is for you. This is a discussion, not therapy or medical advice.

Afterwards we usually continue over dinner nearby, a good chance to connect with fellow builders and practitioners.
